verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Job . . . answered
verses.literalPt: RESPONDEU, porém, Jó, dizendo:

verses.original: עַד־ אָ֭נָה תּוֹגְי֣וּן נַפְשִׁ֑י וּֽתְדַכְּאוּנַ֥נִי בְמִלִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh tō·wḡ·yūn nap̄·šî ū·ṯə·ḏak·kə·’ū·na·nî ḇə·mil·lîm
verses.literal: How long . . . will you torment me and crush me with your words
verses.literalPt: Até quando afligireis a minha alma, e me quebrantareis com palavras?

verses.original: זֶ֤ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּ֭עָמִים תַּכְלִימ֑וּנִי לֹֽא־ תֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: zeh ‘e·śer pə·‘ā·mîm taḵ·lî·mū·nî lō- ṯê·ḇō·šū tah·kə·rū- lî
verses.literal: Ten times now you have reproached me you shamelessly mistreat me
verses.literalPt: Já dez vezes me vituperastes; não tendes vergonha de injuriar-me.

verses.original: וְאַף־ אָמְנָ֥ם שָׁגִ֑יתִי אִ֝תִּ֗י תָּלִ֥ין מְשׁוּגָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄- ’ā·mə·nām šā·ḡî·ṯî ’it·tî tā·lîn mə·šū·ḡā·ṯî
verses.literal: Even if I have truly gone astray my error concerns me alone
verses.literalPt: Embora haja eu, na verdade, errado, comigo ficará o meu erro.

verses.original: אִם־ אָ֭מְנָם עָלַ֣י תַּגְדִּ֑ילוּ וְתוֹכִ֥יחוּ עָ֝לַ֗י חֶרְפָּתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ā·mə·nām ‘ā·lay taḡ·dî·lū wə·ṯō·w·ḵî·ḥū ‘ā·lay ḥɛr·på̄t·tī
verses.literal: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my disgrace . . . against me
verses.literalPt: Se deveras vos quereis engrandecer contra mim, e argüir-me pelo meu opróbrio,

verses.original: דְּֽעוּ־ אֵ֭פוֹ כִּי־ אֱל֣וֹהַּ עִוְּתָ֑נִי וּ֝מְצוּד֗וֹ עָלַ֥י הִקִּֽיף׃
verses.transliteration: də·‘ū- ’ê·p̄ōw kî- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ‘iw·wə·ṯā·nî ū·mə·ṣū·ḏōw ‘ā·lay hiq·qîp̄
verses.literal: then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me
verses.literalPt: Sabei agora que Deus é o que me transtornou, e com a sua rede me cercou.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן אֶצְעַ֣ק חָ֭מָס וְלֹ֣א אֵעָנֶ֑ה אֲ֝שַׁוַּ֗ע וְאֵ֣ין מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: hên ’eṣ·‘aq ḥā·mās wə·lō ’ê·‘ā·neh ’ă·šaw·wa‘ wə·’ên miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Though I cry out Violence I get no response though I call for help there is no justice
verses.literalPt: Eis que clamo: Violência! Porém não sou ouvido. Grito: Socorro! Porém não há justiça.

verses.original: אָרְחִ֣י גָ֭דַר וְלֹ֣א אֶעֱב֑וֹר וְעַ֥ל נְ֝תִיבוֹתַ֗י חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יָשִֽׂים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rə·ḥî ḡā·ḏar wə·lō ’e·‘ĕ·ḇō·wr wə·‘al nə·ṯî·ḇō·w·ṯay ḥō·šeḵ yā·śîm
verses.literal: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass He has veiled . . . my paths with darkness
verses.literalPt: O meu caminho ele entrincheirou, e já não posso passar, e nas minhas veredas pôs trevas.

verses.original: כְּ֭בוֹדִי מֵעָלַ֣י הִפְשִׁ֑יט וַ֝יָּ֗סַר עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḇō·w·ḏî mê·‘ā·lay hip̄·šîṭ way·yā·sar ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ rō·šî
verses.literal: He has stripped me of my honor . . . and removed the crown from my head
verses.literalPt: Da minha honra me despojou; e tirou-me a coroa da minha cabeça.

verses.original: יִתְּצֵ֣נִי סָ֭בִיב וָאֵלַ֑ךְ וַיַּסַּ֥ע כָּ֝עֵ֗ץ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yit·tə·ṣê·nî sā·ḇîḇ wā·’ê·laḵ way·yas·sa‘ kā·‘êṣ tiq·wā·ṯî
verses.literal: He tears me down on every side until I am gone He uproots my hope like a tree
verses.literalPt: Quebrou-me de todos os lados, e eu me vou; e arrancou a minha esperança, como a uma árvore.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣חַר עָלַ֣י אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי ל֣וֹ כְצָרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·ḥar ‘ā·lay ’ap·pōw way·yaḥ·šə·ḇê·nî lōw ḵə·ṣā·rāw
verses.literal: His anger burns against me and He counts me among His enemies
verses.literalPt: E fez inflamar contra mim a sua ira, e me reputou para consigo, como a seus inimigos.

verses.original: יַ֤חַד׀ יָ֘בֹ֤אוּ גְדוּדָ֗יו וַיָּסֹ֣לּוּ עָלַ֣י דַּרְכָּ֑ם וַיַּחֲנ֖וּ סָבִ֣יב לְאָהֳלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ya·ḥaḏ yā·ḇō·’ū ḡə·ḏū·ḏāw way·yā·sōl·lū ‘ā·lay dar·kām way·ya·ḥă·nū sā·ḇîḇ lə·’ā·ho·lî
verses.literal: His troops advance together they construct a ramp against me and encamp around my tent
verses.literalPt: Juntas vieram as suas tropas, e prepararam contra mim o seu caminho, e se acamparam ao redor da minha tenda.

verses.original: אַ֭חַי מֵעָלַ֣י הִרְחִ֑יק וְ֝יֹדְעַ֗י אַךְ־ זָ֥רוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥay mê·‘ā·lay hir·ḥîq wə·yō·ḏə·‘ay ’aḵ- zā·rū mim·men·nî
verses.literal: He has removed my brothers from me my acquaintances . . . have abandoned me
verses.literalPt: Pôs longe de mim a meus irmãos, e os que me conhecem, como estranhos se apartaram de mim.

verses.original: חָדְל֥וּ קְרוֹבָ֑י וּֽמְיֻדָּעַ֥י שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḏə·lū qə·rō·w·ḇāy ū·mə·yud·dā·‘ay šə·ḵê·ḥū·nî
verses.literal: My kinsmen have failed me and my friends have forgotten me
verses.literalPt: Os meus parentes me deixaram, e os meus conhecidos se esqueceram de mim.

verses.original: גָּ֘רֵ֤י בֵיתִ֣י וְ֭אַמְהֹתַי לְזָ֣ר תַּחְשְׁבֻ֑נִי נָ֝כְרִ֗י הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gā·rê ḇê·ṯî wə·’am·hō·ṯay lə·zār taḥ·šə·ḇu·nî nā·ḵə·rî hā·yî·ṯî ḇə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: My guests and maidservants count me as a stranger I am a foreigner in their sight
verses.literalPt: Os meus domésticos e as minhas servas me reputaram como um estranho, e vim a ser um estrangeiro aos seus olhos.

verses.original: לְעַבְדִּ֣י קָ֭רָאתִי וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה בְּמוֹ־ פִ֝֗י אֶתְחַנֶּן־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘aḇ·dî qā·rā·ṯî wə·lō ya·‘ă·neh bə·mōw- p̄î ’eṯ·ḥan·nen- lōw
verses.literal: I call for my servant but he does not answer though I implore him with my own mouth
verses.literalPt: Chamei a meu criado, e ele não me respondeu; cheguei a suplicar-lhe com a minha própria boca.

verses.original: ר֭וּחִֽי זָ֣רָה לְאִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝חַנֹּתִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י בִטְנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: rū·ḥî zā·rāh lə·’iš·tî wə·ḥan·nō·ṯî liḇ·nê ḇiṭ·nî
verses.literal: My breath is repulsive to my wife and I am loathsome to my own family . . .
verses.literalPt: O meu hálito se fez estranho à minha mulher; tanto que supliquei o interesse dos filhos do meu corpo.

verses.original: גַּם־ עֲ֭וִילִים מָ֣אֲסוּ בִ֑י אָ֝ק֗וּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ־ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ‘ă·wî·lîm mā·’ă·sū ḇî ’ā·qū·māh way·ḏab·bə·rū- ḇî
verses.literal: Even little boys scorn me when I appear they deride me
verses.literalPt: Até os pequeninos me desprezam, e, levantando-me eu, falam contra mim.

verses.original: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי כָּל־ מְתֵ֣י סוֹדִ֑י וְזֶֽה־ אָ֝הַ֗בְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ־ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ti·‘ă·ḇū·nî kāl- mə·ṯê sō·w·ḏî wə·zeh- ’ā·haḇ·tî neh·pə·ḵū- ḇî
verses.literal: All my best friends . . . despise me and those I love have turned against me
verses.literalPt: Todos os homens da minha confidência me abominam, e até os que eu amava se tornaram contra mim.

verses.original: בְּעוֹרִ֣י וּ֭בִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָ֣ה עַצְמִ֑י וָ֝אֶתְמַלְּטָ֗ה בְּע֣וֹר שִׁנָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘ō·w·rî ū·ḇiḇ·śā·rî dā·ḇə·qāh ‘aṣ·mî wā·’eṯ·mal·lə·ṭāh bə·‘ō·wr šin·nāy
verses.literal: My skin and flesh cling to my bones I have escaped by the skin of my teeth
verses.literalPt: Os meus ossos se apegaram à minha pele e à minha carne, e escapei só com a pele dos meus dentes.

verses.original: חָנֻּ֬נִי חָנֻּ֣נִי אַתֶּ֣ם רֵעָ֑י כִּ֥י יַד־ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נָ֣גְעָה בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥān·nu·nî ḥān·nu·nî ’at·tem rê·‘āy kî yaḏ- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah nā·ḡə·‘āh bî
verses.literal: Have pity on me my friends have pity . . . for the hand of God has struck me
verses.literalPt: Compadecei-vos de mim, amigos meus, compadecei-vos de mim, porque a mão de Deus me tocou.

verses.original: לָ֭מָּה תִּרְדְּפֻ֣נִי כְמוֹ־ אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י לֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh tir·də·p̄u·nî ḵə·mōw- ’êl ū·mib·bə·śā·rî lō ṯiś·bā·‘ū
verses.literal: Why do you persecute me as God does Will you never get enough of my flesh
verses.literalPt: Por que me perseguis assim como Deus, e da minha carne não vos fartais?

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן אֵ֭פוֹ וְיִכָּתְב֣וּן מִלָּ֑י מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֖ן בַּסֵּ֣פֶר וְיֻחָֽקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tên ’ê·p̄ōw wə·yik·kā·ṯə·ḇūn mil·lāy mî- yit·tên bas·sê·p̄er wə·yu·ḥā·qū
verses.literal: I wish . . . . . . that my words . . . . . . were recorded and inscribed in a book
verses.literalPt: Quem me dera agora, que as minhas palavras fossem escritas! Quem me dera, fossem gravadas num livro!

verses.original: בְּעֵט־ בַּרְזֶ֥ל וְעֹפָ֑רֶת לָ֝עַ֗ד בַּצּ֥וּר יֵחָצְבֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘êṭ- bar·zel wə·‘ō·p̄ā·reṯ lā·‘aḏ baṣ·ṣūr yê·ḥā·ṣə·ḇūn
verses.literal: by an iron stylus on lead or chiseled in stone forever
verses.literalPt: E que, com pena de ferro, e com chumbo, para sempre fossem esculpidas na rocha.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי גֹּ֣אֲלִי חָ֑י וְ֝אַחֲר֗וֹן עַל־ עָפָ֥ר יָקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî gō·’ă·lî ḥāy wə·’a·ḥă·rō·wn ‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār yā·qūm
verses.literal: But I know that my Redeemer lives and in the end He will stand upon the earth
verses.literalPt: Porque eu sei que o meu Redentor vive, e que por fim se levantará sobre a terra.

verses.original: וְאַחַ֣ר ע֭וֹרִֽי נִקְּפוּ־ זֹ֑את וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י אֶֽחֱזֶ֥ה אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar ‘ō·w·rî niq·qə·p̄ū- zōṯ ū·mib·bə·śā·rî ’e·ḥĕ·zeh ’ĕ·lō·w·ah
verses.literal: Even after my skin has been destroyed . . . yet in my flesh I will see God
verses.literalPt: E depois de consumida a minha pele, contudo ainda em minha carne verei a Deus,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִ֨י׀ אֶֽחֱזֶה־ לִּ֗י וְעֵינַ֣י רָא֣וּ וְלֹא־ זָ֑ר כָּל֖וּ כִלְיֹתַ֣י בְּחֵקִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ’ă·nî ’e·ḥĕ·zeh- lî wə·‘ê·nay rā·’ū wə·lō- zār kā·lū ḵil·yō·ṯay bə·ḥê·qî
verses.literal: I will see Him for myself my eyes will behold Him and not as a stranger How my heart yearns within me
verses.literalPt: Vê-lo-ei, por mim mesmo, e os meus olhos, e não outros o contemplarão; e por isso os meus rins se consomem no meu interior.

verses.original: כִּ֣י תֹ֭אמְרוּ מַה־ נִּרְדָּף־ ל֑וֹ וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ דָּ֝בָ֗ר נִמְצָא־ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯō·mə·rū mah- nir·dāp̄- lōw wə·šō·reš dā·ḇār nim·ṣā- ḇî
verses.literal: If you say Let us persecute him since the root of the matter lies with him
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, que devíeis dizer: Por que o perseguimos? Pois a raiz da acusação se acha em mim.

verses.original: גּ֤וּרוּ לָכֶ֨ם׀ מִפְּנֵי־ חֶ֗רֶב כִּֽי־ חֵ֭מָה עֲוֺנ֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב לְמַ֖עַן תֵּדְע֣וּן שַׁדִּין׃ס
verses.transliteration: gū·rū lā·ḵem mip·pə·nê- ḥe·reḇ kî- ḥê·māh ‘ă·wō·nō·wṯ ḥā·reḇ lə·ma·‘an tê·ḏə·‘ūn šad·dīn
verses.literal: then you should fear . . . the sword yourselves because wrath brings punishment by the sword so that you may know there is a judgment
verses.literalPt: Temei vós mesmos a espada; porque o furor traz os castigos da espada, para saberdes que há um juízo.
